name: feral slider
description: Every time you blink, this debris-wielding feral is in a different place.  They are always in motion without actually crossing the intervening space.

special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s tries to hit you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to hit <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s hits your %2$s without penetrating your armor.

special_attacks.//: Feral melee skill + weapon's to hit, so 3+0=3, +2 for being harder to predict because of space warping
special_attacks.//2: all melee damage is decreased by 10% with assumption it is at least `|/` broken
special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: The air around %1$s's hands distorts and they hit your %2$s with their weapon!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: The air around %1$s's hands distorts and they hit <npcname>'s %2$s with their weapon!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s tries to hit you as the air around their hands warps, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to hit <npcname> as the air around their hands warps, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: The air around %1$s's hands distorts and they hit your %2$s without penetrating your armor.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: The air around %1$s's hands distorts and they hit <npcname>'s %2$s without penetrating their armor.

special_attacks.monster_message: %1$s glances at %3$s and the world lurches.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s touches you and the world shifts around you!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s touches <npcname> and the world shifts around them!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %s reaches for you but you avoid their touch!

name: ephemeral riftwalker
description: This feral barely seems to exist in the real world.  They constantly vanish and reappear, weird light and strange mist following in their wake.

death_function.message: As the %1$s dies, the air warps around them!

//: No wielded pipe on this one because they're too dimensionally unstable for it.

name: feral mender
description: Other than the intense expression, this feral human looks to be the picture of health.  They could have starred in a healthcare advertisement before the Cataclysm.  Only the jagged bit of wood clutched like a club indicates something is wrong.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s reaches for you you and you feel weaker!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s tries to touch you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to touch <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s touches you but only hits your armor.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s touches <npcname> but only hits their armor.

name: feral regenerator
description: This feral human doesn't even have bloodshot eyes.  Their skin shines, their eyes are clear, and they move with a relaxed confidence among the apocalypse.  Only the indifference of the nearby zombies indicates something is deeply wrong.

description: This is the healthiest person you've even seen, especially after the end of the world.  Their skin positively glows, and as you watch them brush past a jagged chunk of wood to get to you, the wound they receive immediately stops bleeding and rapidly begins to close.

death_function.message: As %s succumbs to their wounds, they suddenly rise up with new vigor!
